headline: Central Bank of Uzbekistan Seeks to Reduce Economy Dollarization
summary: Uzbekistan's central bank governor urged households and businesses to shift toward national currency borrowing to manage exchange risks and speed up state bank privatizations.
why: De-dollarization efforts aim to strengthen domestic monetary policy control in developing economies.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Central Bank introduced policies to reduce domestic dependency on foreign currencies.
